scope: FP-P3T round2: further directed register cuts inside fp_exec/scalar_unit to break the remaining 831-level combinational chain reported by T-20260902-022; cover CMP/MINMAX/FRINT/FP-to-int and half-lane paths; update lcvex_fp_exec_tb latency assertions; keep raw-bit/order/single-in-flight semantics.

implementation.summary: Added fp_other_pre_t unpacked/flushed operand stage and uses_other_pre pipeline for FCMP, FMIN/FMAX/FMINNM/FMAXNM, FRINT, FCVTZS/FCVTZU in the FP_ITER=1 release branch. The scalar unit IT_PREP now finishes these operations one cycle after unpack/flush, so the request-to-response combinational path is split before result mux. Half-lane 4H/8H use separate lo/hi pipeline registers. Single outstanding transaction, held response, reset/kill, FPCR snapshot and FPEN trap semantics are unchanged.

semantics.raw_bit: unchanged; finish functions reuse the same unpack/compare/minmax/frint/fp_to_int logic from the legacy helpers
semantics.commit_order: unchanged; still single outstanding fp_exec transaction
semantics.fpsr_fpcr: unchanged; FPCR snapshot still locked at request acceptance; FPSR OR still at commit
semantics.kill_reset: pp_other* cleared on kill/reset; no ghost response

runs.notes: Verilator lint-only on lcvex_core with release filelist

runs.command: conda run -n lcvex verilator --binary --timing --assert -j 1 --top-module lcvex_fp_exec_tb rtl/lcvex_pkg.sv rtl/lcvex_fp_scalar.sv rtl/lcvex_neon_fp.sv tb/sv/lcvex_fp_exec_tb.sv && ./obj_dir/Vlcvex_fp_exec_tb
runs.notes: Includes FADD/NEON FADD latency, new FCMP/FMIN/FCVTZS/FRINTZ latency assertions, FDIV/FSQRT iterative, single issue, held response, kill/reset

not_run: Quartus full-FP synthesis/fitter/STA (belongs to next FP-P5 rerun)
known_limits: No physical timing run in this task; actual Fmax/slack must be confirmed by next FP-P5 rerun.
round_pack itself is not further split this round; if the next STA top-N is pp_pre->finish_pre or pp_other->finish_*, a normalize/round split is required.
MOV and special-value DIV/SQRT remain short combinational paths; not expected to be the 831-level main chain but listed for next STA review.
EMIF/sys CDC hold/recovery/removal negatives are outside this task and still require separate RTL synchronization work.
